blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: Kitab is heading ke foran baad 11.2.1 shuru karti hai. Nomenclature ka matlab hai compounds ke naam rakhne ka tareeqa. Is hisse mein hum IUPAC ke usoolon (rules) se naam rakhna seekhenge: 11.2.1 mein alkanes aur alkyl groups, 11.2.2 mein branched (shakhon wale) alkanes ke rules, aur 11.2.3 mein cycloalkanes.

blocks.prompt: Organic chemistry mein IUPAC ke tareeqe se naam rakhna kyun zaroori hai?
blocks.explanation: Carbon atoms barhne ke saath mumkin hydrocarbons ki tadaad bohat barh jati hai, aur bohat se compounds ka molecular formula aik hi hota hai. Sab se lambi chain, numbering aur substituents se bana IUPAC naam har structure ko alag pehchanta hai; isobutane jaise aam (common) naam bare molecules ke liye yeh kaam nahi kar sakte.

items: IUPAC nomenclature alkanes, alkyl groups aur cycloalkanes ke naam rules ke mutabiq rakhti hai (11.2.1 se 11.2.3).
